formulaBlock.normalization: Packet list already normalized (synonym variants are single entries); positions cited are normalized one-based positions (ID-2), identical to the packet order.

cleansingStrength.rationale: `moderate` by C1: defining anionic Sodium Laureth Sulfate@2, prominent buffer Cocamidopropyl Betaine@4, no prominent reinforcing route; TEA-Dodecylbenzenesulfonate@16 is after the E3 point (recorded only). Sodium Xylenesulfonate@3 hydrotrope.

conditioningLevel.rationale: `moderate`: C2 not met because the silicones (Dimethiconol@11, Dimethicone@14) are listed after the fragrance marker Parfum@6 and are therefore supporting routes only (C2 'early' = prominent); no prominent payload lipid replaces them. Anchors: one meaningful silicone/guar system (Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride@13) plus light routes (Glycol Distearate@9, Glycerin@23, Panthenol@25). Neighbor `high`: every other C2 element is present and the E3 point is very early in this list, so the silicone system may well be substantive.

wLineRecord.testedCandidate: Parfum@6 is the only candidate up to the cap: (i) Sodium Laureth Sulfate@2 before it; (ii) nothing between it and the cap -> plausible; W-line = cap

weightPotential.depositionLoad: moderate — silicone system (Dimethiconol + Dimethicone) with a cationic guar; silicones are read wherever listed (W-LINE item 5).
weightPotential.persistence: moderate — persistent silicones via guar coacervate; no amino-silicone, no lipid.
weightPotential.resetCapacity: moderate — C1 ether-sulfate chassis with a betaine buffer.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: Silicone plus guar in an ordinary sulfate/betaine chassis plausibly leaves noticeable but bounded residue.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not `high`: W1 not applicable (no amodimethicone; no presumption), no third family, no lipid, no W-RICH, reset not limited. Not `low`: two families incl. a persistent silicone system (W2).
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: silicone/guar doses unknown; two-family convergence keeps `high` realistic.
weightPotential.rationale: `moderate`: silicone + guar under an ordinary C1 reset (6.6). Neighbor `high`.

focusPrimary.counterSignal: Claims are hidden in the blind pass; focus is claim-led (7.2) and cannot be set from the formula alone.

focusPrimary.rationale: Provisional (formula-only): `general` because no claim is visible; the formula care-direction verdict is recorded before claims (7.3) and the neighbor names the most plausible formula-compatible focus.

focusSecondary.decisionTrace: Blind pass: empty default considered; no distinct positioning visible (claims hidden), so no secondary can be selected (Section 8).
focusSecondary.rationale: Provisional (formula-only): `[]` — Section 8 requires distinct exact-product positioning, which is hidden in the blind pass.

usageRole.rationale: Provisional (formula-only): default `regular` (Section 9); every non-default trigger needs a moderate/high-graded claim or direction, all hidden in the blind pass. cleansingStrength `moderate` fixes which triggers remain possible: `treatment` fires only with a moderate/high-graded E2 dandruff claim (U3) — Piroctone Olamine present; `alternating` impossible (not strong).

scalpComfortTarget.mildBase: excluded — Sodium Laureth Sulfate@2 is a prominent strong anionic
scalpComfortTarget.rationale: `not_targeted`, decided by the formula: CSA FAILS — no E4 comfort or humectant/refatting route is prominent (Niacinamide@24, Panthenol@25 and Glycerin@23 are all after Parfum@6). MB: excluded — Sodium Laureth Sulfate@2 is a prominent strong anionic. Without a listed prominent route and without MB, even an explicitly positioned product is `not_targeted` (Section 10), so positioning cannot change the value; a sensitive/dry claim at reveal would trigger S-FAIL with the missing route named.

dandruffSupport.rationale: `supported`: complete INCI contains Piroctone Olamine@10 (Section 11 table). Formula-only property; a dandruff target additionally needs a dandruff claim (S-DANDRUFF, R17.3).
